N: Our school has four courses. Course A is weekday evenings, focused on conversation. Course B is Saturday mornings, studying grammar thoroughly. Course C is online, and you can choose your time freely. Course D is exam preparation, held on weekday afternoons.
M: I have more chances to speak at work, so I want to practice conversation. My work finishes at six.
F: I want to take the exam next year, but I work during the day... Something I can do at home at any time would be good.
M: Then I'll go with that one.
why: She works days and wants to study at home at any time, so Course C fits.
